indicator_name: Bank loans to the economy issued during the month, by purpose and borrower (incl. construction and purchase of housing)
description: Кредиты банковского сектора экономике, выданные за месяц, по целям кредитования и заёмщикам (в т.ч. на строительство и покупку жилья)
unit: million KZT, issued during the month
methodology: NBK formId=493 (see LOANS_ISSUED_BY_INDUSTRY). Items: BUS, HH; <BUS|HH>.<purpose>; <purpose> over all borrowers; <BUS|HH>.<KZT|FX>. HOUSING = «строительство и приобретение жилья гражданами»: HH.HOUSING is the mortgage-type lending to individuals (265.1 bn KZT in August 2026), HOUSING adds the small business part. Dated by the month of issue (report_date shifted back a month). August 2026: TOTAL 3 859.4 bn KZT, HH.CONSUMER 1 399.2 bn, BUS.WORKING_CAPITAL 1 315.5 bn. Report dates from 2026-05-01 fetched; earlier values kept from the archive.
